Large lockers: Space for 3-5 jackets = 70 DKK


HANGAREN:
Hangaren at Refshalevej 185 is an old hangar construction turned into a nightclub for electronic music and event space. Hangaren is located at a secluded green spot on Refshaleøen in central Copenhagen. We are here to present the city's vibrant electronic music scene. You will be treated with a heavy soundsystem by Lambda Labs. There is a cosy courtyard with chill-out possibility, a bonfire, big sky scenery from where you can watch the sunset, the stars and the sunrise. The bar serves organic beers, drinks at fair prices. Our main purpose is to serve as a platform and inspiration for the cultural scene in Copenhagen


THIS IS HOW WE PARTY:
Hangaren wants every guest to feel safe and free at our parties. This is a shared space and there should be an open atmosphere where everyone can enjoy themselves, whoever they are or wherever they come from. We do not want any harassment based on race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, body size, political orientation, social background or age. If you feel you are being harassed, a victim of nonconsensual touching, or otherwise made to feel unsafe by any form of aggressive or inappropriate attitude, contact our staff or security: they will assist you. It's only a party if we all feel free!

- No photos and video

- Stay in the moment!

- No phones or loud conversations at the dancefloor

- Dancefloor is for dancing, Please respect the vibe!

- Take care of yourself and each other

Please contact our staff if you need help or assistance of any kind.

name: New Song Circle - December
description:
The New Song Circle is your monthly songwriters' new song workshop. Last Sunday of the month. It's free and no registration needed.

If you have a new song, an old song, part of a song, an idea for a song, even less, or just want to help your fellow songwriters in their work, show up and workshop with the host and other songwriters, it's usually even fun! Come, come, come!

The circle is hosted by various regular listening roomies or other fabulous songwriters, this time by Christa Wolf, who is both! 
 
After the New Song Circle, the Listening Room will happen as usual from 19.30, with open stage registration from 19:15.

name: Spleen United - Ekstrakoncert – A Celebration at VEGA - VEGA - Venteliste
description:
Spleen United – A Celebration at VEGA
____________________________________________________________

Døre: 19.00
Koncertstart: 20.00
Billetpris: 395 kr. inkl. gebyr. 
_____________________________________________________________

Spleen United – A Celebration at VEGA bliver en totaloplevelse, hvor publikum får alt: musikken, historien, rummet og festen. Tre aftener dedikeret til et album, der stadig vibrerer og et band, der stadig flytter grænser.

 "Da VEGA spurgte, om vi havde lyst til at opskalere koncerterne til en full-blown fejring af Godspeed, var der ingen tvivl herfra", forklarer Bjarke Niemann.

Med tre aftener i træk forvandles VEGA til et levende univers under titlen Spleen United – A Celebration at VEGA. Publikum kan se frem til mere end koncerter. Det bliver tre dage med lys, lyd, installationer og fest, hvor hele huset summer af Spleen Uniteds energi. 

Inden lyset dæmpes og koncerten går i gang i Store VEGA, kan gæsterne træde ind i en særlig installation i VEGA LAB. Oplevelsen bliver både sanselig, interaktiv og oplagt til deling. 

Udstillingen i VEGA LAB fortsætter fejringen med billeder, grafik og originale genstande fra bandets tidlige år, blandt andet den ikoniske discokugle fra Godspeed-coveret.

I Ideal Bar kan man inden koncerterne genopleve Spleen Uniteds legendariske MTV-optræden fra 2006. 

Når koncerterne runder af, er festen langt fra forbi. Spleen United vender tilbage i Lille VEGA, når salen forvandles til en elektronisk oase med et eksklusivt set; en energifyldt rejse inspireret af bandets lydunivers, hvor beats, bas og nostalgi mødes i et nyt efterspil.

Order of Magnitude x Familiegilde : Julemix @ Den Anden Side

Friday, December 26 │ Soft Selection │ Trance, Tek
————

The friends and family gathering - colloquially known as "Familiegilde" is moving indoors. We were banished from the forest and channeling the spirit of the ghost of christmas present the family has been invited to stay indoors for a night in the great company of DAS.

A variety of trance, tek and bass music alike the former will be presented in an easily digestible way. It would not be a Familiegilde without the crooked benches and firepit, therefore we of course made sure to bring them for your comfort as we will guide you through the Christmas times with our friendly bass music.

𝗔𝘀𝘁𝗮 𝗙𝘂𝗴𝗮𝘇𝗶
Raw bass power in your face. Guarantee of great tek, bass and heavy kicks pushing your eardrums to their limits. A true hero in the freeparty scene. Viva torpatek.

𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗺𝘆𝗶𝗮
Timmyia has complete control over ambiance. They blend ambient with club music. At this event, Timmyia will deliver a club set focusing on the more energetic and obscure sides of their musical expression.

𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗺𝗶𝘅 
Wilian is a backyard pioneer and DJ spinning the raw edge of sunshine Goa - the kind that keeps you dancing long after you think you’re done.

𝗙𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗰 
Have you ever wondered what that beautiful dusty Moth, hanging in the upper left corner of your living room sounds like? Well, here is your chance.Known for producing music which includes the sound of a heavy and smooth rolling bass, that can only be mastered by Ferenc himself. Voilà, prepare for takeoff and enjoy.

𝗡𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗼𝗲𝗹𝘀
Niels is one of my best friends. A true hero of my life. I'm not sure what he is going to play, but I hope for a splat-attack. How does break beat mix with trance?

𝗺𝗮𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗿𝗿 
maurinstarr is the solo project of Christian Loeve from Tisvilde, Denmark. And now from the heart of Slice Town he creates music so driving it tried to enroll itself into driving school but failed the parallel parking. It’s a storm of eerie, trippy yet inviting sounds that makes the seagulls forget how to fly, the jellyfish float to the surface and whirlpools to appear to suck everything back into the depths of Maurinstarr’s soundscape universe. In Tisvilde they don’t say “the waves are wild today” - they say “It’s must be Maurinstarr playing music again”.

name: Dextro's Discoteque @ Den Anden Side
description:
Dextro's Discoteque @ Den Anden Side

Saturday, December 27 │ Soft Selection │ Trance, Bounce

————

Dextros discotheque - the sugarcoated highlight of this Christmas!

For this fourth installment we both take over the club's big room and sound system while delivering a fresh, hard and local lineup AND flying the Hard bounce all star and mastermind behind the bounce label Round 165  DERJAY directly in from Germany for his Copenhagen debut.

DERJAY
Born and raised in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, DERJAY is an emerging force in the harder side of electronic dance music. Specializing in HardBounce and HardDonk at 155–168 BPM, he brings an explosive energy to every stage he steps on. His signature sound blends pounding kicks, driving basslines, and infectious melodies—crafted with the clear goal of pushing the boundaries of the genre.

DERJAY is not just a DJ; he is a dedicated producer who fills his sets almost entirely with his own original tracks, giving his performances a unique and unmistakable identity. With each release, he continues to refine his style and build a growing community of fans who share his passion for fast, dynamic, and high-impact music.

As his presence in the scene keeps expanding, DERJAY is also developing his own label, Round165, a platform designed to highlight the energetic essence of his sound while supporting up-and-coming artists within the HardBounce and HardDonk landscape.
Driven by passion and powered by relentless creativity, DERJAY is rapidly becoming a name to watch in Europe’s harder music movement—both behind the decks and behind the studio desk.

name: Juleaften i LGBT+ Medborgerhuset
description:
Kalder dig indenfor regnbuens farver – dig, der gerne vil fællesskabet og saucen, men måske ikke har nogen at holde jul med. Kom til juleaften i LGBT+ Medborgerhuset!

Den 24. december inviterer vi indenfor i varmen til julemad, julekager og juletræ. Vi skal være sammen på en uformel, ubetinget og hyggelig måde: spise god mad, spille brætspil, rafle og nyde småkager. Man behøver hverken holde i hånd, danse om træet eller synge salmer, hvis man ikke har lyst. Maden er klassisk julemad – and, kartofler, rødkål og den slags – og det er gratis! Vi sørger for alkoholfri drikkevarer, og andet må man medbringe selv.

Det’ sørme, det’ sandt, det’ gratis – men tilmelding er nødvendig, så følg billetlinket.

Aftenens program:
Kl. 17.00: Ankomst, julegodter og julemusik
Kl. 18.30: Maden serveres
Kl. 22.00: Tak for i aften

Har du brug for at komme lidt før og finde dig til rette? Så er du meget velkommen til at komme lidt før vi starter. Vi har også et mindre lokale, hvor man kan trække sig ind, og finde lidt ro og stilhed i løbet af aftenen, hvis man har behov for det. Vi ved, at julen kan være en udfordrende tid for mange queerpersoner, men sammen kan vi få en hyggelig aften i godt selskab <3

Har du yderligere spørgsmål til aftenen? Vil du hjælpe til med at pynte op, dække bord eller lave mad? Skriv til medborgerhus@lgbt.dk

Informationer om adfærdskodeks og tilgængelighed i Medborgerhuset findes her: https://medborgerhus.lgbt.dk/om-lgbt-medborgerhuset/

God december <3

name: Særtilbud til årskortholdere: Vennedage
description:
Har du årskort til Glyptoteket? Så kan du tage en ven med på museet 27., 28. og 30. december. Det er gratis at din ven med ind, når blot du viser dit årskort.

Henvend jer i billetsalget for at få udleveret en gratis entrébillet på dagen for jeres besøg (dvs. én gæst, hvis du har almindeligt årskort, og to gæster, hvis du har årskort plus 1).

Har du ikke årskort? Så kan du købe det her: https://glyptoteket.dk/besog/aarskort

______

Special Offer for Season Ticket Holders: Bring-a-Friend Day

Do you have a season ticket to the Glyptotek? Then you can bring a friend to the museum for free on 27, 28 and 30 December — just show your season ticket at the entrance.

Visit the ticket counter on the day of your visit to collect a free admission ticket (one guest with a standard season ticket, or two guests with a "Season Ticket Plus 1").

Don't have a season ticket? You can buy one here: https://glyptoteket.com/visit/season-ticket
